title: Design: Move Customers greyed without the customer permissions
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: A user with Finance settings but no customer editing opens COD's row menu, and you compare it with the design.
  • You are signed in as {User-A}, working in {Location-A}, and the role of {User-A} has Settings → Finance but not Customers → Create & Edit.
    For example: {User-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-48 Finance only and {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Due on Receipt is the default for new customers.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p2-09-without-the-customer-permissions.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the COD row.
  2. Hover "Move Customers".
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the row menu opens: "Make Default for New Customers" is normal and "Move Customers" is greyed.
  • Step 2: a dark grey box opens to the left of the menu on one line: "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." (as in ct-p2-09-without-the-customer-permissions.png).
  • Step 3: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-N1: “If the user has 'Settings → Finance' but lacks 'Customers → Create & Edit' or 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', "Move Customers" shows greyed in every row menu with the hover text "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." A move sent by other means without all three permissions is refused by the server.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover a greyed Move Customers (missing permission) | "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." | Tooltip on hover, item greyed”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "2 Move customers to another term" ("Without the customer permissions"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p2-09-without-the-customer-permissions.png

The design's own words:

  • “A user with Settings → Finance but without Customers → Create & Edit or View and Manage AP/AR Data sees Move Customers greyed in every row menu, with the hover text "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." (S4-N1). They can still make a default.”
